waitForCompletion.description: Poll the async execution, by the executionId the backend returns, until it finishes: onSuccess then runs with its outputs, onError on failure or timeout. A failed status request does not fail the wait, polling continues until timeout. onStart, onSuccess and onError see the store as it is when they run. The workflow needs enableAudit: true, otherwise the backend keeps no execution record and the wait ends in a timeout. Polling stops when the hosting dialog or screen closes. Without it the action behaves as before.

pollInterval.description: waitForCompletion only: milliseconds between status checks

timeout.description: waitForCompletion only: milliseconds to wait before giving up and running onError

onStart.description: waitForCompletion only: actions run right after the execution is created, before polling starts; executionId is available
